revised_prompt: Create a professional, horizontal LinkedIn company cover banner supporting a web development consultancy named Good Flippin Design. Dimensions: wide banner format of 1128x191 pixels. Dark charcoal background (#0d0d0d to #1a1a1a gradient). On the left side, place a circular glowing geometric logo symbol glowing with purple (#8b5cf6) and teal (#10b981) luminescence. In the center-right, have the text 'GOOD FLIPPIN DESIGN' in a modern, sans-serif style similar to the Inter font. A subtitle 'Strategic Web Development' in smaller, crisp white (#f5f5f5) text is to be placed below. The right side should feature a subtle data visualization or node network graphic. Overall aesthetic should be professional, technical, and premium with a clean, modern, minimal design. Ensure text readability at small sizes. The style should convey a photorealistic 3D render, professional brand banner, and clean layout.
